messages:
jamal: Quick check — we received an erasure request for customer ACME (ticket #5421). Can we delete traces older than 90 days from s3://redwood-debug/debug-snapshots/acme/? What's the approval flow here? cc @maria @alex.m

maria: Do those traces include full request bodies or just metadata+kv-cache? If full bodies then legal/compliance must sign off.

alex.m: They include full request payloads for some debug dumps (we kept a few full dumps to reproduce issues). There is definitely PII in a handful. We don't have an automated TTL on that prefix.

lisa: Security check — we need the data owner (prod-eng) + compliance ticket before deletion. Also want the exact S3 prefix and a short sample key list.

jamal: path: `s3://redwood-debug/debug-snapshots/acme/` example keys: `acme/2023-07-12/req-3f2a.log`, `acme/2023-08-01/dump-9b1c.tar.gz` — I'll open the compliance ticket now.

compliance-bot: Erasure request #5421 recorded. Please attach the signed DSR and confirm whether you want redaction or full deletion. Note: full deletion requires ops approval.

jamal: I'll attach the DSR. Prefer full deletion if compliant. Who can perform the one-off delete? @sre-oncall?

sre-oncall: I can do the delete. Need a scoped IAM role or a presigned list and an exact key list/command. Prefer running `aws s3 rm --recursive --exclude "*" --include "acme/*" --bucket redwood-debug --prefix debug-snapshots/acme/ --dryrun` first, then actual delete during a maintenance window.

maria: Also add a short retention artifact: a redaction log that lists keys removed (no payloads) and keep it in the secure audit bucket for 30 days per policy before purging.

lisa: Confirming: security approves deletion after compliance ticket and DSR attached, and SRE runs the deletion with documented steps. If anyone objects tag now. :eyes:

jamal: I'll create the compliance ticket and attach DSR + list of keys. Thanks — will ping here when ready for SRE to execute. :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: Sounds good. Once jamal posts the final key list I'll run the delete and post the `aws s3` output here.

maria: One more: if you find any customer-owned blobs in other prefixes, stop and re-open the ticket — don't proceed without confirmation.

jamal: Noted. Will verify scope before handoff.
